name: Doomwarder Blood
summary: Doomwarder Blood is gathered from powerful demons near Mannoroc Coven in Desolace. Kreldig Ungor needs ten vials for a mage’s experiments.

sections.title: A Demon’s Blood
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor in Desolace asks for ten vials of Doomwarder Blood as the final part of his request for Reagents for Reclaimers Inc. The blood comes from Doomwarder Captains or lords among the demons near Mannoroc Coven. Kreldig warns that collecting it is harder than gathering the other reagents, and the demons are far from the land’s centaur camps.

faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor needs ten vials of Doomwarder Blood for Reagents for Reclaimers Inc., a set of reagents requested for a mage’s experiments.

faq.q: Where does Doomwarder Blood come from?
faq.answer: Doomwarder Blood comes from Doomwarder Captains and lords near Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Kreldig want the blood?
faq.answer: Kreldig gathers the blood as one of three reagents for a mage’s experiments.
Kreldig asks for ten vials of Doomwarder Blood.

faq.q: Is the blood the only reagent Kreldig needs?
faq.answer: No. Kreldig also asks for ten Felhound Brains and ten Nether Wings.
